title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The path widens, expanding out into an oval around a stone starfish fountain with a shallow stone pool beneath it.  This fixture dominates the area and is surrounded by children playing by the pool's edges, customers stopping to appreciate the fountain, and tired-looking vendors sitting cross-legged by the water.  Above, a wide sailcloth sheet dyed a bright violet attached to shops on either side of the promenade overhangs the scene, enclosing the area in an attempt to give it greater serenity.
